titulo_es: A great man: position and degree of the adjective

velho.consejo: The context and the position guide the meaning.

texto: Some adjectives change their nuance according to their position: **um grande homem** usually praises a person; **um homem grande** normally describes their size. **Um velho amigo** is often a long-time friend; **um amigo velho** may refer to his age. The context decides the meaning.

**-íssimo/-íssima** expresses a very high degree: **claríssimo** (very clear). **-inho/-inha** may indicate small size or affection: **uma casinha** (a small / dear house). It's not always a literal diminutive.

frases.pt: O jornal publicou a história de um grande homem que dedicou a vida à investigação.
frases.es: El periódico publicó la historia de un gran hombre que dedicó la vida a la investigación.
frases.en: The newspaper published the story of a great man who dedicated life to research.

frases.pt: Na fotografia, vê-se um homem grande junto de uma porta estreita.
frases.es: En la fotografía se ve a un hombre corpulento junto a una puerta estrecha.
frases.en: In the photograph you see a man of the corpulent by a narrow door.

frases.pt: A jornalista descreveu a casa como “pequena, mas claríssima”, e chamou-lhe uma casinha acolhedora.
frases.es: La periodista describió la casa como «pequeña, pero muy luminosa», y la llamó una casita acogedora.
frases.en: The journalist described the house as «small, but very bright», and called it a cozy house.

bloques.pregunta: What is the size of «um grande homem» in the text?

opciones.texto: It's a compliment for your trajectory.
opciones.explicacion: The text highlights its commitment to research.
That description appears with «um homem grande».

bloques.pregunta: What does «claríssima» mean in this context?

opciones.explicacion: Intensify the description of the house.
The door, not the house, is narrow.

bloques.frase: O jornal publicou a história de um grande homem.

opciones.texto: The newspaper published the story of a great man.
opciones.explicacion: The adjective stand has a laudable nuance.

opciones.texto: The newspaper published the story of a man of the world.
opciones.explicacion: That nuance is usually expressed after the name.

opciones.texto: The newspaper published a very big story.
opciones.explicacion: It changes the adjective and the reference.
After the name it usually describes size.
It intensifies the degree, but it's not the form of the text.

bloques.pregunta: What does «um homem grande» describe in the second text?

opciones.explicacion: The adjective goes after the name.
That's the praising nuance of «um grande homem».

intro: The adjective position can change the nuance. The suffixes also allow for evaluation or intensification.
